versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- No other functional changes included in this version.

Initial release of 图表生成工具 (MCP ECharts):

- Provides dynamic chart generation and data analysis powered by Apache ECharts.
- Supports multiple chart types: line, bar, pie, radar, scatter, sankey, funnel, gauge, treemap, sunburst, heatmap, candlestick, boxplot, network graph, parallel coordinates, tree.
- Integrates MinIO object storage and various export formats (PNG, SVG, ECharts option).
- Enforces mandatory API key configuration and secure workflow for chart requests.
- Adopts clear routing and parameter extraction workflow for handling user intents and tool selection.
